The '''Cor'ric sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] situated within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], near the [[Portmoak sector/Legends|Portmoak sector]].
